acceptance_criteria.description: Five failures are admitted, the next request is rejected with 429 and an integer database-clock Retry-After, and rejection does not increment either counter.
evidence: tests/integration/api/auth/login-throttling.test.ts: admits five failures, then returns 429 with a database-clock Retry-After without another increment
Focused PostgreSQL result: 2 files, 58 tests passed

acceptance_criteria.description: Normalized email variants share a limit, real client IPs are isolated, and spoofed x-forwarded-for does not select the IP subject.
evidence: tests/integration/api/auth/login-throttling.test.ts: shares the email counter across D-50 normalization variants
tests/integration/api/auth/login-throttling.test.ts: isolates real client IPs and ignores spoofed x-forwarded-for values

acceptance_criteria.description: Unknown email, invalid password, and correct-password suspended account failures have the same safe response, charge both limits, and never create a suspended-account session.
evidence: tests/integration/api/auth/login-throttling.test.ts: makes unknown, wrong-password, and correct-password suspended failures indistinguishable and charges both limits
Database assertion: six counter rows at count 1 and zero sessions

acceptance_criteria.description: Pre-throttled requests do not verify credentials or increment counters, while successful active login consumes no failure counter.
evidence: The pre-throttled test installs an invalid stored hash after reaching both limits; 429 instead of a verifier error proves credential verification was skipped, counts remain 5, and no session exists.
The successful active-login test returns 200 with one session and no RateLimitWindow rows.

acceptance_criteria.description: Counters persist through suspension and reinstatement, expire by their fixed window, and do not prevent a later valid active login.
evidence: tests/integration/api/auth/login-throttling.test.ts: keeps counters through suspension and reinstatement, then admits again after the fixed window expires
The test observes both counters at 5, a throttled correct login with zero sessions, then a 200 and one session after the stored fixed window becomes old.

acceptance_criteria.description: A limiter database failure fails closed with a safe 503 and no database detail.
evidence: tests/integration/api/auth/login-throttling.test.ts: fails closed with a safe 503 when the limiter table is unavailable
The response code is service_unavailable and the body excludes relation, table, SQL, and PostgreSQL detail.

acceptance_criteria.description: A rejected login limit records both D-47 rate_limit.rejected and auth.login_throttled events for the actual rejecting limit.
evidence: tests/unit/identity/auth-service.test.ts: records the rejected rate limit and auth throttle against the actual pre-throttled limit
src/server/services/identity/auth.ts records both projected security events without email, IP, password, or key data.
